description: This source file defines the CredentialTypeResolver class, which is responsible for resolving credential types during JSON serialization and deserialization. It maps between string identifiers and credential classes such as PasswordCredential, PskCredential, and X509CertificateCredential, and provides mechanisms for type identification based on credential object instances.

classes.name: CredentialTypeResolver
classes.description: A Jackson type id resolver that maps credential classes to string IDs and vice versa, based on credential type instances.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the resolver with a base JavaType for deserialization.

methods.name: getMechanism
methods.description: Returns the mechanism type used for type identification, here 'NAME'.

methods.name: idFromValue
methods.description: Determines the string type ID from a credential object instance.

methods.name: idFromValueAndType
methods.description: Determines the string type ID based on object instance and specified subtype.

methods.name: typeFromId
methods.description: Resolves a JavaType from a string ID during deserialization.
